title: Transfection of Micromonas commoda CCMP2709
author: Lisa Sudek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8p9hvr6
materials: Resuspend the cell pellet in 46.2 µl of the SF buffer/supplement solution (Lonza) prepared above (step 14) and quickly add the cell suspension to the mastermix (see below) at 2 µl per transfection reaction. Carefully mix by gentle pipetting.

steps.title: Prepare Reporter Plasmid Stock
steps.instruction: Transform the reporter plasmid (e.g., RPS9proMco-eGFP) into Escherichia coli (E. coli) XL-Blue Competent Cells following manufacturer instructions.

substeps.instruction: Grow transformed E. coli on LB-Ampicillin (LB-Amp) plates (100 µg ml-1) at 37°C overnight (16-18 hr).
Inoculate one colony into 5 ml liquid LB Amp medium (100 µg ml-1) and grow at 37°C and ~250 rpm for ~16 hr.
Centrifuge culture at 6000 x g for 10 min, remove supernatant, and resuspend pellet in 5 ml LB medium.
Inoculate 220 ml LB-Amp medium (100 µg ml-1) with 2 ml of the cell suspension and grow at 37°C and ~200 rpm for ~16 hr.
Purify the plasmid using the Qiagen Maxi Prep Kit per manufacturer instructions.
Quantify concentration using a NanoDrop™ One/OneC Microvolume UV-Vis Spectrophotometer, aiming for 5-10 µg µl-1 (ideally 10 µg µl-1).
Aliquot into 1.7 ml microcentrifuge tubes and store at -20°C.

steps.title: Prepare L1 Medium and Culture Micromonas
steps.instruction: Prepare L1 medium in a natural seawater base adjusted to 22 PSU (e.g., 550 ml natural seawater from North Eastern Pacific, 36 PSU + 450 ml 18.2 MΩ·cm MilliQ H2O).

substeps.instruction: Set growth chamber to 21°C with a 14:10-h light:dark cycle (~140 µmol photon m-2 s-1 PAR).
Transfer culture approximately every 3 days to a density of 4 x 10 6 cells ml-1.
Maintain M. commoda in mid-exponential growth for ≥10 generations for transformation experiments (expected growth rate 0.56 ± 0.06 day-1).

steps.title: Prepare Buffers and Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the Recovery Buffer and ATP solution.

substeps.instruction: Recovery Buffer (100 ml): Mix 1 ml 1M HEPES pH7.5, 99 ml 18.2 MΩ·cm MilliQ H2O, 4.7g PEG 8000, and 10.2 g D-Sorbitol (final concentrations: 10 mM HEPES-KOH pH 7.5, 530 mM Sorbitol, 4.7% w/v PEG 8000, salinity 22 PSU). Filter sterilize (0.2 µm), aliquot into 2 x 50 ml tubes, and store at 4°C.
ATP solution (100 ml): Add 15.13 g ATP to 100 ml 18.2 MΩ·cm MilliQ H2O. Adjust to pH 7.5 with NaOH. Filter sterilize (0.2 µm), aliquot into 10 ml tubes, and store at 4°C (final concentration 250 mM).

steps.title: Set Up Nucleofector and Workspace
steps.instruction: Configure the Lonza 4D-Nucleofector™ System and prepare the sterile environment.

substeps.instruction: Create a template file in the Lonza program, selecting wells to be pulsed and choosing the 'Cell type program'.
Select pulse EW-113 for experimental wells and 'no program' (no pulse) for controls.

Wipe the laminar flow hood and the following items with 70% EtOH: pipettes/tips (1-1000 µl), L1 medium, sterile 12-well culture plates, waste beaker, 1.7 ml Eppendorf tubes, multichannel pipette (100 µl), 96-well nucleofection plate, and disposable pipette basin.

steps.title: Harvest Micromonas Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare the cell suspension for transfection.

substeps.instruction: Determine cell concentration using a flow cytometer (e.g., BD Accuri C6); target concentration is 15 to 22 x 10 6 cells ml-1.
For 22 reactions, harvest 46.2 ml of culture by centrifuging in 50 ml conical tubes at 5000 x g for 10 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and store the pellet at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare Transfection Mastermix
steps.instruction: Thaw Carrier DNA (pUC19, 20 µg µl-1), reporter plasmid (RPS9proMco-eGFP, 10 µg µl-1), Recovery Buffer, ATP (250 mM), and Lonza buffer SF (amended with supplement V4-SC-2096) on ice.

substeps.instruction: Create a mastermix per reaction containing: 15 µl Buffer SF (Lonza), 2 µl pUC19 (20 µg µl-1), 1 µl ATP solution (250 mM), 2 µl reporter DNA (10 µg µl-1), and 2 µl cell suspension in SF buffer.
Add the cell suspension last and mix gently by slow pipetting.
Run transfection reactions and no-pulse controls in 4 biological replicates.

steps.title: Perform Nucleofection
steps.instruction: Apply the electrical pulse to the cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 22 µl of nucleofection mixture per well of a 96-well nucleofection plate (Lonza V4SP-1096).
Insert the plate (with lid) into the 96-well Shuttle™ System and apply pulse EW-113.
Verify pulse success via colorimetric indicator (Green = success, Red = failed).
Immediately add 100 µl of ice-cold Recovery Buffer to each well to re-seal pores.
Gently mix by tapping the sides of the plate and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Post-Transfection Recovery and Growth
steps.instruction: Transfer cells to culture plates and monitor growth.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 ml of L1 medium to each well of a 12-well culture plate.
Transfer each transfection reaction to a separate well, mixing gently by pipetting before transfer.
Allow cells to rest for 30 min at room temperature.
Subsample 50 µl from each well to determine cell concentration via flow cytometry (average 3.27 x 10 6 cells ml-1).
Incubate plates at 21°C under a 14:10-h light:dark cycle with increasing light intensity: Day 0-1 (30 µmol photon m-2 s-1), Day 1-2 (40 µmol photon m-2 s-1), and Day 2-7 (80 µmol photon m-2 s-1).
Subsample for flow cytometry on days 2, 3, 4, and 6 to calculate transfection efficiencies and growth rates.
